turns.response_html:
A Zebulon knot is a decorative, multi-strand knot often used in scout crafts to create necktie slides (woggles) or decorative rings. It is structurally similar to a Turk’s head knot but typically features a more compact, three-dimensional cylindrical shape.

  • Structure: It is woven using a single cord that passes under and over itself to form a symmetrical lattice.
  • Utility: While primarily ornamental, its tight grip makes it useful for securing cylindrical objects or creating grips on tool handles.
